t: What Pollinator Health Database Is All About
title: What Pollinator Health Database Is All About
description: Pollinators enable a third of crops: honeybees (managed, ~2.5M US hives), bumblebees, mason bees, and hoverflies. Threats stack: Varroa mites (the #1 honeybee killer), neonicotinoid pesticides, habitat loss, and poor nutrition. Colony Collapse Disorder (2006+) alarmed the world; Varroa plus viruses explained most of it. Habitat — diverse flowers across seasons — is the foundation fix. This database is the complete pollinator record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
